# Code Chaos

> Code Chaos is a Hitech Psytrance, Psycore and Darkpsy music producer from Hamburg, Germany, and the studio project of Tim Borchert, active since 2016 with 24+ releases. Code Chaos is a studio project only: no live shows, events or DJ bookings. Tim Borchert also runs **Polished Media** (genre-specific audio mastering, https://polished.media) and **Code Chaos Audio**, an audio plugin series whose first release is **Crucible**, a 3-band harmonic saturation plugin.

Primary site language: German (de). Full English version: https://codechaos-official.de/en/ . The Crucible product page is in English. Domain: https://codechaos-official.de/
Last updated: 2026-10-05

## New single: Uhrwerk aus Blut (30 October 2026)

- **Title:** Uhrwerk aus Blut (German: "Clockwork of Blood"). Single by Code Chaos.
- **Release date:** 30 October 2026 (2026-10-30). **Label:** Abstract Sound Design. Available on all major streaming platforms.
- **Genre:** Darkpsy, Hitech Psytrance, Gothic.
- **Tagline:** "Ein Herz, das zu schnell schlägt. Ein Uhrwerk, das blutet." (A heart that beats too fast. A clockwork that bleeds.)
- **Story in five scenes:** Prolog, I Die Uhr, II Der Spiegel, III Das Blut, Rückkehr.
- **Pre-Save:** https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/codechaos/uhrwerk-aus-blut-2
- Voices and artwork were created with AI. It opens a new era for the project: darker, narrative, gothic.

- Tracklist: Cold Boot (145 BPM), Bitrot (146), Runtime Terror (233, E Phrygian), Overdrive (220), Fork Bomb (228), Hyperthread (245), Ego Death (210), Core Dump (199), Night (180).

## Key facts

- **Artist:** Code Chaos (real name Tim Borchert), Hitech Psytrance, Psycore, Darkpsy producer from Hamburg, Germany. Studio project only.
- **Self-described style:** "New Psychedelic Death Art". Bio line: "Code Chaos does not make music for the daylight."
- **Active since:** 2016. **Releases:** 24+ on labels incl. Abstract Sound Design (Germany, co-founded by Code Chaos in 2021), TATEWARI Records (Mexico), Soma Ritual Records (India).
- **Tempo range:** 180–300 BPM. Genres: Hitech Psytrance (170–230 BPM), Psycore (180–300+ BPM), Darkpsy / Dark Psytrance (150–200 BPM).
- **Booking:** not available (no live shows or DJ sets).

## Mastering (Polished Media)

- Genre-specific mastering for Psycore, Hitech Psytrance and Darkpsy by an active producer.
- Single (stereo mastering, 1 track): €79 · Stem Pro (stem mastering, up to 6 stems): €129 · delivery 48–72 h.
- EP (up to 5 tracks): €349 instead of €395 (save €46, ~12%), €69.80 per track, 5–7 days.
- Album (up to 10 tracks): €629 instead of €790 (save €161, ~20%), €62.90 per track, 7–14 days, vinyl-ready master on request.
- All prices incl. 19% German VAT; audio audit and unlimited revisions in every package; delivery as 24-bit WAV, 16-bit AIFF and 320 kbps MP3. Same prices as https://polished.media
- Payment: in advance or by invoice after completion, as the client prefers.
- Extras: Cover Art €99, Lyric Video €179, Promo Video (60 s) €299.

## Code Chaos Audio, Plugins

- **Crucible** 1.0.0, a 3-band harmonic saturation plugin: VST3 + standalone for Windows 10+. Price: €49 on Gumroad (single-user, perpetual license).
  - Splits the signal into Low, Mid and High bands, each saturated independently.
  - Five saturation types, selectable per band: Hard Clip, Wavefolder, Tube, Diode, Tape.
  - Per-band Drive, Mix and Gain; adjustable crossovers; per-band Mute/Solo; oversampling up to 4x.
  - Built for Psytrance, Hitech, Psycore and Darkpsy producers, but works on any source (mixing & mastering).
  - Tagline: "Shape. Saturate. Dominate." / "From subtle warmth to full-on destruction."
  - Buy / download: https://timberwolf688.gumroad.com/l/crucible
  - Product page: https://codechaos-official.de/crucible.html

## Definitions (genre guide)

- **Psycore:** A Psytrance subgenre at 180–300+ BPM combining dark psychedelic soundscapes with hardcore energy; dense atmospheric pads, experimental sound design, minimal sine-wave percussion. Typical range 190–240 BPM.
- **Hitech / Hi-Tech Psytrance:** Fast (≈170–230 BPM, typically 180–200), complex, glitchy, hyper-detailed psychedelic trance; can be dark or euphoric.
- **New Psychedelic Death Art:** Code Chaos' self-coined name for the project's sound: hitech, psycore and darkpsy (180–300 BPM) with gothic atmosphere, liquid FM lines, a constantly rolling bass and narrative voices. First release of this era: "Uhrwerk aus Blut" (2026).
- **Darkpsy / Dark Psytrance:** Slower (≈150–200 BPM, typically 155–175) but atmospherically intense, occult and dark soundscapes; the evolutionary basis of Hitech and Psycore.
- Psycore artists (selection): Phreneticus (Salzburg), Apollyon, Tzu-Jan, Fele, Xenrox, Code Chaos.
- Hitech artists/DJs (selection): Highko (German pioneer, with Cosmo), Psykovsky, Alien Chaos, Will O Wisp, Inner Coma, Killa TK, Gotalien, Audiopathik, BionicForm, Xenrox, Mad Scientist, Code Chaos.
- Darkpsy artists/DJs (selection): Xenomorph (Mark Petrick, Berlin), Kindzadza (Moscow), Fungus Funk (Moscow, since 2001), Psykovsky, Para Halu (Hungary), Baphomet Engine (Brazil), Cosmo, Code Chaos.
- Full genre guides (German): https://codechaos-official.de/psycore/ · https://codechaos-official.de/hitech-psytrance/ · https://codechaos-official.de/darkpsy/
- Full genre guides (English): https://codechaos-official.de/en/psycore/ · https://codechaos-official.de/en/hitech-psytrance/ · https://codechaos-official.de/en/darkpsy/
